about: V5 script (V4 picture timing): 26 lines with timing, what is on screen, caption beats and the product claims each line makes. Copy source: src/data/navislabs_v5_copy.json. Final takes go to public/voiceover/final/v4/Vxx.wav (no code change).
direction: Abhishek Meena's own voice (or an ElevenLabs clone of it made with his permission). Calm, deep, precise, technical, confident, understated, founder-led — natural to Abhishek's own accent. Not a commercial announcer, trailer voice, AI voice, overly American, overly dramatic, or fast social-media narration.
